GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Caught 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 3 Lengths 700m, Hard Ridden getting Wide from the corner, weakened last 200m and was virtually eased down last 150m # worked too hard
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover. Eased down over the concluding stages. A post-race vet exam failed to reveal any abs. Official trial due to its performance.
Jumped in the air at the start and then bumped with NEW YORK GAL shortly after the start. Raced wide from the 400m point for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well and Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together up front & led 2 Lengths jointly turning, railed to short Lead rounding turn then Headed Straightening Up and dropped right out in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed it to be lame in the right foreleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Underwent a post-race veterinary examination which revealed the mare to be lame in the right-foreleg. Trainer G Thwaite was advised the mare would require a veterinary certificate prior to again being permitted to start in a race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , Went Forward and sat on Leaders heels 1 Lengths 800m, loomed and joined Leader soon after Straightening Up and they paired off, took over last 200m and proved too strong to the line # strong on pace win
Jumped okay & Settled Down 1.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 3 Lengths 2-3 Wide turning, Held Ground in straight. (Cross-over Nose Band OFF AGAIN) # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length then even slower into stride, Settled Down last 10 Lengths on fence, made no ground to turn, Made Some Ground in straight. (Bubble Cheeker (Near Side) ON, Compression Hood With Ear Muffs OFF, Cross-over Nose Band ON) [Stewards: Fractious in barrier.] # slow out/slow early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fractious in the barrier. Began awkwardly and was slow into stride. Became awkwardly placed on heels having to be momentarily steadied approaching the 400m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Caught Wide 3 Lengths (500m), Lost Ground before Turn , Straightened Up going nowhere shown the stick, gave Ground (Compression Hood With Ear Muffs FIRST TIME) # struggling b4 turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in on entering the home straight before being corrected. Raced wide for the majority.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well Wide out settled down third 1-2 Lengths (700m), length or So Further back Soon After , cornered Under Pressure shown the stick, no run on # faded straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From the wide barrier shifted behind runners in the early stages. Laid in for some distance passing the 800m and obliged to steady off heels.
